title: 第2492章 帝兵战帝主第2491章 帝主真身
content_zh:
三大帝兵之中，九霄帝剑的怒气最为强烈，攻伐也最为凶猛，仿佛恨不得将黑暗帝主立劈！
原因无他，它身为帝剑，此前却被黑暗帝主震飞了，哪怕对方是一位将成道者，也是它不能忍受的耻辱！
这样的将成道者，它并非没有斩过！
而且，是在九霄剑帝还未真正晋入帝境的时候，他遭遇了此生最大的劲敌，是一个比他更早迈入准帝层次的强者，法力滔天，战力如海！
但他还是被九霄剑帝斩杀了，准帝血染红了帝剑，化作一抹烙印，永远地镌刻在剑身上。
此刻，那位昔日的准帝烙印甚至也显化出来了，悬浮在帝剑的周围，随着帝剑一同劈斩而下！
幸好黑暗帝庭的周围没有生命界域，否则在三大帝兵的攻击下，没有什么生灵能够存活下来，都会化为齑粉！
这是让世间所有人都感到恐怖的攻击，无缺帝兵，蕴含着大帝的意志，没有什么不能攻破！
在三大帝兵进攻的刹那，黑暗帝主也出手了，他一张口，虚无空间内无数星辰的精气都被吸纳而来，无视了时间与空间，他立身在那儿，便拥有横压万古的神威！
“我虽掌控黑暗，但硬撼帝兵，打到山河破碎，万界不存，却并非是我的本意。”黑暗帝主轻声自语，掌下却无比凌厉，一掌挥动，虚无空间被撕裂，黑暗洪流淹没了九天十地，不少星辰永远地暗淡了！
嘭！
帝剑之势，锋利到了极致，也狂霸到了极致，但却依旧被黑暗帝主的掌印挡下，世人隔着诸多界域，依旧看到了光与暗的碰撞！
那是绚烂到极致的剑光，和汹涌到极致的黑暗，双方的中间出现了一片真空地带，仿佛让万道都破碎、成空！
几乎在同一时间，永恒的仙光照射而来，似要破灭一切的道与法，那片黑暗都被照亮，仿佛在镜光下无所遁形！
纵然是黑暗帝主，在那刺目的镜光照耀下，他的道躯都生出了一丝刺痛之感，好似有帝道法则侵入了他的体内。
可他身躯猛地一震，就将这股刺痛感化解了，紧接着，黄金鞭打落，隐约可见一尊黄金古帝手执神鞭，聚诸天神灵之威，携破碎万古之势，狠狠地击打而下，要将黑暗帝主打碎！
在这一击面前，纵然是百位、千位的圣王，都难以抵抗，会被瞬间打成肉泥！
一道铿锵之音传出，震颤了万界，有可怕的火星飞溅，让诸圣王露出了惊骇之色。
那是黑暗帝主的权杖击打而出，这件恐怖的准帝器，在黑暗帝主的手中，竟有不弱于帝兵的威势！
只因主人在旁，无穷无尽的准帝法则能够融入黑暗权杖之中，再加上恐怖的材质，使得这权杖爆发出的威力毫不逊色黄金鞭！

嘭！
下一瞬，方圆百万里之地都出现了恐怖的炸裂声响，气浪湮天，遮蔽了一切，这是两大兵器碰撞所致！
“是两尊大帝在战斗吗？”
诸天万界，无尽的生灵在恐惧，只因这等碰撞实在太剧烈，让他们觉得有人在灭世！
紧接着，一股更加狂暴的气息喷薄而出，像是无尽的黑暗符文爆发，那尊黄金鞭竟然被震飞出去，如一颗金色的流星划过虚无空间！
content_en:
Among the three imperial soldiers, the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword has the strongest anger and the most ferocious attacks, as if it wants to chop the Dark Emperor in half!
There is no other reason. As an imperial sword, it was knocked away by the Dark Emperor before. Even if the opponent is a person who will become enlightened, it is a shame that it cannot bear!
It is not that it has never killed such a person who will become enlightened!
Moreover, before the Nine Heavens Sword Emperor truly entered the imperial realm, he encountered the greatest enemy in his life. He was a strong man who had entered the quasi-emperor level earlier than him, with monstrous mana and a sea of ​​combat power!
But he was still beheaded by the Nine Heavens Sword Emperor. The quasi-emperor's blood dyed the emperor's sword red and turned into a brand, engraved on the sword forever.
At this moment, the former quasi-emperor's brand even appeared, floating around the emperor's sword, slashing down with the emperor's sword!
Fortunately, there is no life realm around the Dark Imperial Court. Otherwise, under the attack of the three imperial soldiers, no living thing would be able to survive and they would all be turned into powder!
This is an attack that frightens everyone in the world. It contains the Emperor's will without any shortage of imperial weapons, and there is nothing that cannot be broken!
At the moment when the three imperial soldiers attacked, the Dark Emperor also took action. When he opened his mouth, the essence of countless stars in the void space was absorbed, ignoring time and space. When he stood there, he had the power to overwhelm all eternity!
"Although I control the darkness, it is not my original intention to defeat the emperor's soldiers until the mountains and rivers are shattered and all realms cease to exist." The Dark Emperor whispered to himself, but his palms were extremely sharp. With a wave of his palm, the void space was torn apart, and the torrent of darkness flooded the nine heavens and ten places, and many stars dimmed forever!
Bang!
The power of the emperor's sword was extremely sharp and powerful, but it was still blocked by the dark emperor's palm seal. Across many realms, the world still saw the collision of light and darkness!
It was an extremely splendid sword light, and an extremely turbulent darkness. A vacuum zone appeared between the two sides, as if all the ways were broken and empty!
Almost at the same time, the eternal fairy light shone in, seeming to destroy all Tao and Dharma. The darkness was illuminated, as if there was nothing to hide under the mirror light!
Even though he was the Dark Emperor, under the dazzling mirror light, his Dao body felt a tingling sensation, as if the laws of the Emperor's Dao had invaded his body.
But his body shook violently, and the stinging sensation was resolved. Then, the golden whip fell, and a golden ancient emperor could vaguely be seen holding a divine whip. He gathered the power of the gods in the sky, and with the power of breaking the ages, he struck down hard, trying to break the Dark Emperor into pieces!
In the face of this attack, even hundreds or thousands of holy kings would be unable to resist, and would be beaten to a pulp in an instant!
A sonorous sound came out, shaking the world, and terrifying sparks flew, making all the saint kings look horrified.
It was struck by the Dark Emperor's scepter. This terrifying quasi-imperial weapon, in the hands of the Dark Emperor, was as powerful as the Imperial Soldier!
Just because the master is around, the endless quasi-emperor laws can be integrated into the dark scepter. Coupled with the terrifying material, the power of the scepter is no less powerful than the golden whip!
Bang!
The next moment, there was a terrifying explosion sound in a million miles radius, and the air waves filled the sky and obscured everything. This was caused by the collision of two weapons!
"Are the two great emperors fighting?"
Endless creatures in the heavens and worlds are afraid, just because the collision is so violent that they feel that someone is destroying the world!
Immediately afterwards, an even more violent aura spurted out, like endless dark runes erupting, and the golden whip was blown away, like a golden meteor streaking across the void!
